title: Lift a small cabinet door off its slip-joint hinges and stand it on a bench pad
instruction: Remove the open cabinet door and stand its bottom edge on the green rubber pad. Let go and move both hands clear.
context: General maintenance and repair workers (O*NET 49-9071.00; 1,517,470 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023), carpenters (47-2031.00; 719,860), and cabinetmakers and bench carpenters (51-7011.00; 97,940) routinely remove small cabinet and equipment-access doors hung on lift-off slip-joint hinges (such as Sugatsune NH-40L/SS stainless lift-off hinges, rated 7 kg per pair) for unobstructed interior service, hardware replacement, or refinishing, setting the detached door upright on a protective rubber pad so the panel face and edges are not marred. Because two vertical pins engage close-fitting knuckles 260 mm apart, pulling horizontally jams the knuckles against the pins: both hands must lift the 1.27 kg door straight up clear of both 18 mm pins without binding, carry it clear of the cabinet, and set its bottom edge stably upright on the pad before letting go.
setup: Station coordinates in metres from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left, z up; tabletop z=0.7475 m, arm bases at (0, +/-0.305, 0.750) m). Unpowered cabinet, empty interior: (1) Fixed plywood storage-cabinet carcase, 240 mm deep x 391 mm wide x 420 mm tall (18 mm panels), clamped to the bench, local geometry relative to (0.360, 0, 0.7575) m spanning (-0.006, 0.1715, -0.010) to (0.385, 0.4195, 0.410) m. (2) Loose 350 mm wide x 400 mm tall x 18 mm poplar-plywood cabinet door, 1.267 kg total with horizontal stainless pull (202 mm bar, 192 mm post centres, 35 mm projection at z=+200 mm above door bottom) and two moving hinge halves, starting 90 degrees open. (3) Two Sugatsune NH-40L/SS-class 304-stainless lift-off slip-joint hinges (catalogue envelope 40 x 30 x 7 mm each, shoulder planes 260 mm apart at 50 mm and 310 mm above the door bottom): each fixed lower half carries an upward 3.0 mm diameter x 18 mm vertical pin above a 7.0 mm shoulder, and each moving upper half carries a 20 mm hollow annular knuckle (3.6 mm bore, 0.30 mm radial clearance). Seated door bottom-centre reference is (0.360, 0, 0.7575) m; reset spawns the door at z=0.7577 m (0.2 mm axial gap) so gravity seats it cleanly on the shoulders during settle. (4) Fixed green nonslip rubber pad, 140 x 410 x 4 mm, taped flat at centre (0.250, 0, 0.7495) m, top z=0.7515 m. Both arms start at READY with grippers open; object_jitter=0, control_hz=20. Full component cut-list and material encoding are in inventory.json, SOURCES.md, and geometry.py.
scoring: Current-state endpoint score (`SCORE_OVER='end'`), evaluated at 20 Hz from measured poses, velocities, URDF collision-hull clearances, and filtered door-to-pad contact forces (dropping off the bench or re-engaging a pin loses earlier credit; invalid/non-finite readings score 0): 0.00 while either pin remains inside either knuckle or any vertex leaves the bench; 0.25 once both pins completely clear both moving knuckles above the bench; 0.50 once detached and the door origin has moved at least 80 mm horizontally from its seated hinge origin; 0.75 once additionally safely supported (on the bare bench within 1 mm of tabletop with no pad overlap, or on the pad within 3 mm with upward pad contact force >= 85% of door weight = 10.56 N), released (every collision hull of both robots >= 30 mm clear of the door AABB), and still (linear speed < 10 mm/s, angular speed < 0.05 rad/s, max vertex drift <= 2 mm) continuously for 1.0 s (>= 21 samples); 1.00 (success) when throughout that 1.0 s window the entire door footprint lies inside the 140 x 410 mm pad, the door stands upright within 5 deg of vertical, all four panel bottom corners lie in [-1 mm, +3 mm] of the pad top, and upward door-to-pad contact force stays >= 85% of door weight. On a physical rig, verify pin detachment, 30 mm hand clearance, pad footprint inclusion, 5 deg plumb with a square/level, and 1 s stillness from video.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Lift the door upright, align both open moving knuckles over the two vertical hinge pins at 90 degrees open, lower the door until both knuckles rest squarely on the fixed hinge shoulders at (0.360, 0, 0.7575) m, verify the green rubber pad lies flat on its taped outline, and return both arms to READY with grippers open.
fidelity: Self-authored procedural USDA assets: 350x400x18 mm poplar door (1.267 kg with hardware) and catalogue-envelope NH-40L/SS slip hinges. Each annular knuckle uses 24 convex wedges to preserve the 3.6 mm bore around the 3.0 mm pin in PhysX. Detachment is contact- and gravity-driven with zero joints or pose writes. Fastener threads, wood compliance, and surface marring are omitted; friction coefficients (pad 0.8/0.64, door 0.5/0.4, hinge 0.2/0.16) are estimated engineering values.
